record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.original_question: Do universal infinitesimal symmetries Ṗ=Q(P) of classical Poisson structures survive under Batalin–Vilkovisky quantisation, where the classical master equation [[P,P]]=0 is replaced by iħΔP + 1/2[[P,P]] = 0?

evidence.quote: Problem 19. Likewise, do the universal symmetries P˙ = Q(P) ∈ sym([[P,P]] = 0) persist in the course of the Batalin–Vilkovisky quantisation, ([[P,P]] = 0) ⇒ (iħ ΔP + 1/2 [[P,P]] = 0), of Poisson bi-vectors P ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P$ be a Poisson bi-vector on a smooth (affine) manifold, so that the classical master equation $[\![P,P]\!]=0$ holds, where $[\![\cdot,\cdot]\!]$ denotes the Schouten bracket on multi-vectors. A universal infinitesimal symmetry of the class of Poisson structures is a map $P\mapsto Q(P)$, built from $P$ by a universal (e.g. Kontsevich-graph) formula in the partial derivatives of the components of $P$, such that the flow $\dot P=Q(P)$ preserves the equation $[\![P,P]\!]=0$, i.e. $[\![Q(P),P]\!]=0$ whenever $[\![P,P]\!]=0$.

In the Batalin–Vilkovisky framework, the classical master equation is replaced by the quantum master equation
$$i\hbar\,\Delta P + \tfrac12\,[\![P,P]\!] = 0,$$
where $\Delta$ is the BV Laplacian acting on the relevant space of (formal) multi-vectors / functionals, and $P$ is now allowed to depend formally on $\hbar$.

Question: Does every universal infinitesimal symmetry $\dot P=Q(P)$ of the classical equation $[\![P,P]\!]=0$ (in particular, those produced by the Kontsevich graph construction) persist under Batalin–Vilkovisky quantisation, in the sense that the flow $\dot P=Q(P)$ — possibly after a universal $\hbar$-deformation $Q(P)\mapsto Q_\hbar(P)$ — preserves the quantum master equation $i\hbar\,\Delta P + \tfrac12\,[\![P,P]\!]=0$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the Kontsevich-graph symmetry literature. A 2025 follow-up listing of open problems on Kontsevich graphs acting on Nambu–Poisson brackets still discusses BV-quantisation persistence among unresolved questions, and no published resolution of the persistence under BV quantisation of universal Kontsevich-graph symmetries of Poisson bi-vectors appears in the literature.
